units.source_text: 紫姬心中照例很不高兴。

en.t: Lady Murasaki was, as usual, very unhappy at heart.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣装作不知，开导她说：“

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, pretended not to notice and tried to comfort her, saying, "

units.source_text: 你与她身份悬殊，同她比较是不行的。

en.t: Your rank is far different from hers, so it will not do to compare yourself with her.

units.source_text: 你应该想：尔为尔，我为我。

en.t: You should think: she is she, and I am I.
The right thing is not to compete with her."
He was scheduled to enter the palace that evening.

units.source_text: 此时他转向一旁，忙着写信，大概是给明石姬的。

en.t: At that moment he turned aside and busied himself writing a letter, probably to Lady Akashi.

units.source_text: 从旁望去，但见写得十分详细。

en.t: Looking on from the side, one could only see that he was writing at great length.
He also whispered to the messenger for a long while.
All the waiting women saw this and felt displeased.

units.source_text: 晚上本来想宿在宫中，但因紫姬心绪不佳，终于深夜回家了。

en.t: That night he had originally meant to stay in the palace, but because Lady Murasaki was in low spirits, he finally returned home late at night.

units.source_text: 明石姬的回信早已送到。

en.t: Lady Akashi's reply had already arrived.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣并不隐藏，就在紫姬面前拆阅。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, did not hide it, but opened and read it right in front of Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 信中并无特别使她懊恼的文句，源氏内大臣便对紫姬说：“

en.t: There was nothing in the letter especially likely to upset her, so Genji, the Inner Minister, said to Lady Murasaki, "

units.source_text: 你把这信撕毁了吧！这种东西很讨厌，放在这里，和我的年纪很不相称。”

en.t: You may tear this letter up. Such things are unpleasant, and keeping it here is quite unbecoming for a man of my age."

units.source_text: 说着，将身靠在矮几上了，心中却念念不忘地记挂明石姬，只管望着灯火出神，别无话说。

en.t: As he said this, he leaned against the low table, but in his heart he could not stop thinking of Lady Akashi; he only stared absentmindedly at the lamplight and had nothing more to say.
